import java.util.*;

public class lets_do {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        int[] prefEven = new int[n];
        int[] prefOdd = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if ((arr[i] & 1) == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
            prefEven[i] = even;
            prefOdd[i] = odd;
        }
        List<Integer> weights = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i += 2) {
            if (prefEven[i] == prefOdd[i]) {
                weights.add(Math.abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
            }
        }
        int[] dp = new int[b + 1];
        for (int w : weights) {
            for (int cap = b; cap >= w; cap--) {
                dp[cap] = Math.max(dp[cap], dp[cap - w] + 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp[b]);
    }
}

import java.io.*;

public class lets_do {
    static class FastScanner {
        private InputStream in;
        private int c;

        public FastScanner(InputStream in) {
            this.in = in;
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int val = 0;
            int sign = 1;
            c = in.read();
            while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t') {
                c = in.read();
            }
            if (c == '+' || c == '-') {
                if (c == '-') sign = -1;
                c = in.read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = in.read();
            }
            return val * sign;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner(System.in);

            }

        int p = wlist.size();
        int[] w = new int[p];

            w[i] = wlist.get(i);
        }
        int[][] dp = new int[p + 1][b + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            for (int cap = 0; cap <= b; cap++) {
                dp[i][cap] = dp[i - 1][cap];
                if (w[i - 1] <= cap) {

                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp[p][b]);
    }

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class lets_do {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String all = br.lines().collect(Collectors.joining(" "));
        int[] nums = Arrays.stream(all.trim().split("\\s+")).mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();
        int n = nums[0];
        int b = nums[1];
        int[] a = Arrays.copyOfRange(nums, 2, 2 + n);
        int[] pe = new int[n];
        int[] po = new int[n];
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
            pe[i] = even;
            po[i] = odd;
        }
        int[] w = IntStream.range(1, n - 2)
                .filter(i -> (i & 1) == 1 && pe[i] == po[i])
                .map(i -> Math.abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]))
                .toArray();
        int[] dp = new int[b + 1];
        for (int weight : w) {
            for (int cap = b; cap >= weight; cap--) {
                dp[cap] = Math.max(dp[cap], dp[cap - weight] + 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp[b]);
    }
}
